info.name: CHP approval ledger intake
info.summary: Takes the doc commands' checkout, new, approve, override and publish requests and spools them for the root-owned ledger appender.
info.description: CyberHygiene appliance control app. OCS API POST /api/v1/request and GET /api/v1/result/{request_id}. Each request is stamped with the user NextCloud authenticated (never a name from the request) and how (bearer, app-password, session), checked (Compliance areas only, at most 10 requests a minute per user, 64 MiB for a publish) and written to /var/lib/chp-docs/spool. The app never writes the ledger or the Compliance areas: the root appender does, after checking every Bearer at Kanidm. Policy in app config (set by chp-site): compliance = [area folder ids], superseded = [area folder ids].
